source: experiment.md section 14.1; 2 associate-editor items + reviewer 1 six + reviewer 2 seven + reviewer 3 seven = 22

items.issue: Novelty, conditional theory, bilinear/IRSP/delay ablations unsupported
items.task: Mechanism attribution plus Eq.22 and non-circular proof

items.issue: Force results/work domain conflict with claims; strong baselines, parameters, statistics and presentation inadequate
items.task: Raw peaks, independent validation, literature and applicability domain

items.issue: Module assembly; quality scheduling alone is insufficient novelty
items.task: Closest-method difference table and module necessity

items.issue: Proposed method has larger raw force peaks, conflicting with force-improvement claim
items.task: Joint peak, internal force, tension proxy, impulse and time evaluation

items.issue: Stability relies on log self-certification and circular reasoning
items.task: Derive error domain, terminal/backup and disconnection-density conditions

items.issue: DoS, distributed optimization and digital-twin/safety-estimation positioning are weak
items.task: Primary-source positioning and independent network-baseline qualification

items.issue: Original linear/non-projected bilinear models often outperform proposed model
items.task: Same-identity prediction baselines, projection cost and error decomposition

items.issue: Activation/exit and other parameters lack complete rationale
items.task: Per-value parameter table, healthy thresholds, sensitivity and freeze record

items.issue: Theorem assumes decrease/failure growth/contraction and lacks an actual certificate
items.task: Feasibility and switching derivation plus certificate-failure decomposition

items.issue: Finite-input spectral radius does not guarantee continuous-domain or non-normal contraction
items.task: Norm/common-P counterexamples, input domain and closed-loop relation

items.issue: Removing delay has little effect and removing IRSP can improve results; gains may come from other modules
items.task: True single switches and common bounds; demote no-gain modules

items.issue: AKE-M and hold baselines are too weak
items.task: Tube, affine-feedback and independent network baselines with native-method reproduction

items.issue: SD/CI/statistics absent; sample and seed count inadequate
items.task: Paired trajectory-family statistics, multiple initializations and multiplicity control

items.issue: Self-built plant for train/test and force proxies do not establish real safety
items.task: Independent model, measured calibration and real network/HIL

items.issue: Poor high-speed/hairpin performance and narrow work domain
items.task: Speed/curvature/load/network domain and failure attribution

items.issue: Abstract and related text are overly defensive
items.task: Replace rhetoric with evidence and retain negative results

items.issue: References 10, 13, 14, 15 and 37 lack information
items.task: Verify every reference with publisher sources

items.issue: Authors for references 33, 13 and 37 are incorrect
items.task: Record old/new/source corrections item by item

items.issue: Eq.22 base block can violate the bound even when gamma is zero
items.task: Correct branch, counterexample, source regression and new prediction proof

items.issue: Many modules but insufficient ablation
items.task: Separate architecture, predictor, network, observer, fault and full-combination effects

items.issue: Need genuinely robust/distributed/delay-strong baselines
items.task: Native assumptions/adaptation plus compute/message-cost alignment

items.issue: Title emphasizes delay compensation although observed gain is small
items.task: Delay levels, legal causal timing and title retention decision

claim_boundary: R3-4 confirms only an algebraic counterexample in the candidate source. It does not establish that the submitted manuscript has been identified or that a corrected theorem has been proved. Historical reviewer-reported numbers are not mixed with September 2026 runs.
